Driven by Discovery
Curious Minds. Fearless Innovators. Science Leaders.
The Department of Chemistry, Biochemistry and Physics is where curiosity sparks discovery and innovation drives results. Students work alongside faculty on research ranging from medical diagnostics to space exploration and advanced materials. Our graduates:
Excel at NASA, Sanford Research and Fortune 500 companies
Enter top medical and graduate schools
Inspire future scientists as educators

Our Programs
Chemistry
Study core chemistry disciplines in an American Chemical Society-certified program with state-of-the-art labs in the Avera Health and Science Center.
Graduate ready for top careers or advanced study — our alumni work at Sanford Research, POET, national labs and leading medical and graduate schools.
Discover the central science in ACS-certified labs.
Biochemistry
Explore life at the molecular level in South Dakota’s only American Society for Biochemistry and Molecular Biology-certified biochemistry program, combining chemistry, biology, physics and math.
Conduct research in biomedical fields like cancer, infectious disease and genetics. Prepare for medical school, graduate programs or biotech careers.
Unlock the molecular secrets of life.
Physics
Learn in small, hands-on classes and choose from professional or applied physics, health or medical physics, or a flexible path for double majors.
Participate in cutting-edge research, from NASA space-based neutrino detectors to materials science collaborations with national partners.
Unravel complex mysteries in physics and cosmology.

Research
Advancing Science. Transforming Lives.
From advanced materials to cancer biology, nuclear physics to science education, chemistry, biochemistry and physics research tackles big questions with real-world impact — in partnership with NASA, Sanford Research and leading universities nationwide.
Our researchers are pioneering ultraearly detection and immune-system-based therapy development for cancer. Learn more about our departmental goal for 2035.
Explore matter, life and the universe with chemistry, biochemistry and physics.
